title: 第一卷 第96章 下品灵器金蛟剪第一卷 第95章 神通显威秒杀
slug: 凡人修仙从百岁老人娶妻开始
lines: 林寻手指微动，阵法的中品灵石更换。
木甲缚灵阵运转，将所有人重新笼罩。
得罪本座想跑？
呵！
不过是瓮中鳖。
“前辈饶命！”
求饶声刚起便止。
先被地岩鼠用百张精品符箓洗脸，又被阵法一番折腾。
慕家众修士本就是强弩之末。
现在面对成功筑基，秒杀家主的林寻，哪敢有抵抗的心思。
就算有人想拼一下，也被林寻手中符箓一个个点杀。
半个时辰后。
慕家的最后底蕴，被屠杀殆尽。
林寻抱起地岩鼠，安慰的拍了拍其后背，渡入筑基法力。
随着青色法力渡入，地岩鼠身上伤口以肉眼可见的速度愈合。
他再次喂了两粒丹药，才轻声道，
“辛苦了！”
清理完所有杂鱼，林寻以神识检查自身状态。
“寿元再次大增，一次突破就增加一百五十年，如今能活到三百多岁！
算是彻底脱离了寿命不足的焦虑。
现在正是闯的年纪啊！”
他的眸子闪过一丝喜色。
再就是相貌，筑基有易筋洗髓的功效。
此时形象已然大变，泉水中倒影着青年模样，满头白发彻底逆转为青丝。
连相貌都帅气几分。
他摸了摸自己的脸庞、手掌......脸上浮现出一丝欣慰的笑容。
要知道，当年这个样貌，可是迷倒了仙宗的少女很长一段时间。
只是后来修为停滞不前，才慢慢苍老。
林寻也不急着出去，而是运转功法，吸收池子中的灵气。
很快，他无奈发现，此功法只能缓慢恢复法力，再无精进的可能。
“筑基后，《长春功》就显得废物起来，更换功法的事情，必须提上日程了。”
数日之后。
林寻将自身境界彻底稳固，运转蕴息术，修为迅速收敛为炼气十一层。
content_en:
Lin Xun moved his fingers slightly, and the middle-grade spiritual stone of the formation was replaced.
The wooden armored spirit-binding array was operating, covering everyone again.
You want to run away if you offend me?
Oh!
It's just a turtle in a urn.
"Senior, spare your life!"
"Senior, have mercy on me..."
The cry for mercy stopped as soon as it started.
First, he was washed by the Earth Rock Rat with hundreds of high-quality talismans, and then he was tortured by the formation.
The monks of the Mu family are already at the end of their tether.
Now faced with Lin Xun who had successfully built a foundation and killed the family leader instantly, how could he dare to resist.
Even if someone wanted to fight, they would be killed one by one by the talisman in Lin Xun's hand.
Half an hour later.
The last traces of the Mu family were slaughtered.
Lin Xun picked up the rock rat, patted its back comfortingly, and entered the foundation-building mana.
As the cyan mana flows in, the wounds on the rock rat's body heal at a speed visible to the naked eye.
He fed two pills again and then said softly,
"Thank you for your hard work!"
After cleaning up all the trash fish, Lin Xun checked his own status with his spiritual consciousness.
"The lifespan has increased greatly again, with one breakthrough adding 150 years, and now I can live to be over 300 years old!
It can be regarded as a complete escape from the anxiety of insufficient life span.
Now is the age to break out! "
His eyes flashed with joy.
Then there is the appearance. Foundation building has the effect of relaxing tendons and cleansing marrow.
At this time, the image has changed drastically. The appearance of a young man is reflected in the spring water, and the white hair on his head has completely turned into black hair.
He even looks handsome.
He touched his face and palms... A smile of relief appeared on his face.
You know, this appearance had fascinated the girl from the Immortal Sect for a long time.
It was only later that his cultivation stagnated and he slowly grew old.
Lin Xun was not in a hurry to go out, but was running his skills to absorb the spiritual energy in the pool.
Soon, he found out that this technique could only restore mana slowly, and there was no possibility of improvement.
"After the foundation was established, Changchun Gong seemed to be useless. The replacement of the exercises must be put on the agenda."
...
A few days later.
Lin Xun completely stabilized his own realm, used the aura accumulation technique, and quickly converged his cultivation to the eleventh level of Qi refining.
